simStateSpace

Source: AGENTS.md

This project follows the house rules in your global instructions (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md). This file adds only what is specific to this project.

Read .setup/ai/project.md first. It holds the project facts that the user maintains (aims, data, notation, co-authors, open issues).

Project

  • Name: simStateSpace
  • Type: package, cran
  • Private repository: jeksterslab-psu/simStateSpace (Overleaf pushes here)
  • Overleaf project: not recorded (.setup/repo/private-overleaf.md)
  • Public repository: not recorded (.setup/repo/public-github.md) (make auto pushes here)
  • These come from .setup/repo/ (private). O2G checks the private repository; PUB checks the public one.
  • Image: the user chooses it and runs apptainer exec <image> make <target>; R is not installed on the host. Do not pick an image. When a command needs one, ask, or give the command with <image> for the user to fill in. .setup/ai/project.md may note the image the project usually uses.

Folder map

Folder Contents
R/ package functions, one per file
tests/testthat/ unit tests, one file per function
man/ help pages, generated by roxygen (never edit)
data/ package data (.rda), written by the scripts in .setup/data-process/
inst/ files installed with the package (CITATION, …)
src/ C++ sources, copied from .setup/cpp/ by Build()
vignettes/ vignettes; those with a source in .setup/vignettes/ are generated
.github/workflows/ CI workflows, written by Template() (change them in rProject’s inst/template/)
.sim/ simulation scripts (SLURM, GNU Parallel); a simulation has .sim/README.md
detritus/ LaTeX by-products (the .tex knitted from .Rtex)
.library/ the project’s R library (local only)
.verify/ a clone of the private repository, to check pushes (local only)
quarto/ the rendered Quarto site (Quarto())
.quarto/ Quarto’s cache (local only)
pkgdown/ the rendered pkgdown site (Site())
.claude/ Claude Code’s project settings (private)
.setup/scripts/ project.R (the project’s settings) and the make scripts
.setup/repo/ where the project lives: private and public repository, Overleaf project (private)
.setup/ai/ specs, the plan, the handoff, project.md (private)
.setup/logs/ one log per Overleaf push, and index.md (private)
.setup/notes/ notes and files: claude.txt (resume commands); lib-* keep the reference PDFs here (private)
.setup/todo/ todo.txt, the user’s to-do list, and its attachments (private)
.setup/readme/ README.Rmd, the source of README.md
.setup/latex/ LaTeX sources (.Rtex), preamble/, r-scripts/, bib/, tikz/, sty/, equations/, slides/; pdf/ and figures/ are generated
.setup/quarto/ Quarto site sources
.setup/load/ load.R, which loads the project for knitr and Quarto
.setup/pkgdown/ _pkgdown.yml
.setup/vignettes/ vignette sources that are precompiled (*.Rmd.orig)
.setup/build/ the package tarball and the PDF manual (Build(), Manual())
.setup/cpp/ C++ sources, copied into src/
.setup/r-dependencies/ R functions shared with other packages, copied into R/
.setup/r-miscellaneous/ helpers that are not part of the package (for example texTools)
.setup/tests-benchmark/ benchmark tests, outside the unit tests (test-benchmark-<pkg>-<name>.R)
.setup/tests-external/ external tests, outside the unit tests (test-external-<pkg>-<name>.R)
.setup/bin/ optional: R scripts run at make project (for example, to build a bespoke binary)

Make targets

Target Does
make all build, docs, LaTeX, pkgdown, quarto, coverage
make lint style and lint the R code, and report Overleaf limits
make sizecheck check Overleaf limits; run before uploading
make spec TOPIC=<topic> start a spec for a change set
make log TOPIC=<topic> SUMMARY="..." write the change-set log and its file list (UPDATE=TRUE refreshes the list)
make verify RECORD=TRUE after the user pushes from Overleaf (O2G): verify and record the push. On Roar, run bash .setup/scripts/verify.sh on the host first to pull.
make auto publish to the public repository (checks the export first)
make tree the project’s folders and what each is for; flags missing and non-standard folders
make project settings, template files; restores .setup/scripts/rproject.lock (rProject, image, snapshot)
make upgrade move to the newest rProject; the next make auto updates the lock. Never upgrade a package the image has: add it to the image

Generated files: never edit by hand

NAMESPACE, man/, README.md, CITATION.cff, LICENSE*, .Rbuildignore, project.Rproj, R/RcppExports.R, src/RcppExports.cpp, */bib.bib, vignettes/*.Rmd built from .setup/vignettes/, .setup/latex/pdf/, .setup/latex/figures/, data/*.rda. Change their sources and run make.

Size

Overleaf’s GitHub sync stops above 7 MB of editable text and caps text files at 2 MB. Keep large data compressed (binary, e.g. .Rds or .xz) and never store the same file twice. make sizecheck reports problems.

Package

  • Every exported function has roxygen documentation and tests.
  • make all runs the checks; fix every error, warning, and note.
  • Keep the R style rules from your global instructions (BigCamelCase, one function per file, internal .Foo functions in R/<pkg>-<name>-dot.R).

CRAN

This package is on CRAN or headed there.

  • R CMD check --as-cran must pass with no errors, warnings, or notes, on R release and R devel.
  • Every user-visible change: a version bump and a NEWS.md entry.
  • Examples, tests, and vignettes write only to tempdir(), use at most two cores, and do not need the internet unless skipped (skip_on_cran(), skip_if_offline()). Long examples go in \donttest{}.
  • Before a submission: cran-comments.md (test environments, check results, reverse dependencies) and reverse-dependency checks when the package has any.
  • The user submits to CRAN. Agents prepare the submission; they never submit.
